title: Parts-kit gap audit (task A1, agent PA1)

definitions.buildable_now: every structural need is met by manifest parts or by the machiya's proven building-level helpers (floors, lean-to, udatsu placer, ridge walk); props, interior fittings and materials are not counted

definitions.effort: S = under half an agent session incl. checks; M = about one session; L = two or more
definitions.owner: 'kit' = assembled from the parts kit; PA3 = an outdoor-kit item (KEEP_OUTDOOR build-first)
